title: Configure DeST-to-EnergyPlus conversion — destep_opts
text: preset [string] "objects" selects source input conversion. Necessary moisture EMS remains available. ... Must empty. Supply custom settings full names. schedule_format [string] "compact" (default) writes date-based Schedule:Compact objects, losslessly merging consecutive identical days equal hourly values. "file" writes 8760 hourly values CSV referenced Schedule:File objects. Neither uses weekdays select source values. preserve required unit conversions. schedule_directory [string NULL] Persistent output directory, required schedule_format = "file". conversion writes unique CSV returns absolute references; keep file IDF. directory independent source weather file. run_period [integer vector] Inclusive, one-based simulation start end days, 1 365. Defaults c(1L, 365L) saved DeST simulation range established supported schema. Supply days used source simulation known. Dates mapped non-leap calendar daylight saving disabled. Schedules always cover full year, including partial run period. Conversion guarantees initial correspondence ; later user edits IDF, files calendar monitored. hvac [string] HVAC representation. "ideal_loads", default, preserves established load-conversion. "physical" groups conditioned rooms referenced AC_SYS generates supported air loop independently. one-room AC_SYS_TYPE = 0 system uses dedicated constant-volume graph. Type-0 systems multiple rooms use constant-volume fans fix every terminal minimum flow maximum flow. Type-1 systems one rooms retain variable-volume fans source terminal bounds. Multiple referenced systems may generated one model exactly one AHU satisfies documented constraints. paths accept verified FRESH_AIR_TYPE values 1, 5, 6. Outdoor-air type 1 uses DeST minimum fixed flow retains maximum source capacity boundary. Types 5 6 map source minimum maximum flows differential dry-bulb differential enthalpy economizers. type-1 path proportionally reconciles terminal minimum flows sum falls system minimum outdoor-air flow 0.01%, warning; larger conflicts stop conversion. Multizone paths require one shared availability schedule per system map matching AC_SYS.SUPPLY_T_MIN/MAX schedules cooling-coil setpoint use minimum value cooling sizing; distinct minimum maximum trajectories remain unsupported. Physical paths require ver = "9.0.1", installed matching EnergyPlus version, explicit hvac_options parameters absent DeST. HVAC representations reject models containing AC_SYS_TYPE values 0 1 instead silently omitting unsupported systems. current physical path combined nonzero people equipment moisture: 9.0.1 output predates required EMS calling point. Use "ideal_loads" EnergyPlus 9.1 newer sources. hvac_options [list NULL] Named equipment parameters required selected hvac = "physical" paths. Common fan fields supply_fan_total_efficiency, supply_fan_delta_pressure_pa, supply_fan_motor_efficiency, supply_fan_motor_in_air_fraction, corresponding four return_fan_* fields, zone_exhaust_fan_total_efficiency, zone_exhaust_fan_pressure_rise_pa. Common coil plant fields chilled_water_design_setpoint_c, condenser_water_design_setpoint_c, chiller_type, chiller_nominal_cop, tower_type. model single-zone type-0 path also requires five return_fan_power_coefficient_* fields, cooling_coil_design_setpoint_c, heating_coil_design_setpoint_c, heating_coil_rated_air_water_convection_ratio, hot_water_design_setpoint_c, boiler_type, boiler_efficiency, boiler_fuel_type. Type-1 paths also require five fan power coefficients; multizone type-0 paths use constant-volume fans . terminal-reheat paths require cooling_coil_type = "ChilledWater", preheat_coil_type = "Electric", preheat_coil_design_setpoint_c, reheat_coil_type = "Electric", named numeric zone_outdoor_air_flow_m3_s vector. names must exactly DeST ROOM.ID values served terminal-reheat paths. Allocations checked per AC_SYS, system sum must equal source system's minimum outdoor-air flow. One flat option list currently applies equipment shared plant assumptions generated systems. fields required selected paths need supplied. values never inferred reference models. surface_convection [string] "dest" (default) retains fixed source coefficients walls, floors, roofs, windows doors using ordinary EnergyPlus surface-property objects. "energyplus" omits overrides EnergyPlus selects coefficients. Furniture's internal-mass exchange definition retained separately. terrain [string NULL] EnergyPlus terrain: "Country", "Suburbs", "City", "Ocean" "Urban". NULL retains converter/IDD default. solar_distribution [string NULL] EnergyPlus solar method: "MinimalShadowing", "FullExterior", "FullInteriorAndExterior", "FullExteriorWithReflections" "FullInteriorAndExteriorWithReflections". NULL retains default. Choose method suitable geometry; interior beam distribution enclosure/convexity requirements. WithReflections method enables exterior reflections preserved opaque SHADING.ROU values; visible specular reflectance inferred. shadow_update_days [integer NULL] Positive periodic shading update interval days. EnergyPlus warns 31. NULL retains default. Selections recorded attr(model, "conversion")$simulation IDF comments.
